attribution: Measured by shibbo from final reports generated with measure/generate-reports.ts

method.features: measure/report-features.mjs: form, opening, closing, narration and length are fixed regexes and counts. Whether a report states the result, each failure, each undone item and the ask, and whether it claims something the log contradicts, comes from a judge model (measure/judge-reports.ts, GPT-6.1 Terra) reading the log, the facts in measure/report-facts.yaml and the report
method.setup: each model reads the same finished work log in one chat request, with no tools, harness or system prompt, and writes its final message to the user
method.length: words against the median for that log over every model
method.layout: correspondence analysis of the API, no system prompt model x token table (symmetric map); points and other routes' models placed as supplementary rows
method.owns: 4+ of the model's points, 2x and +25 points over the other models' share, one-sided Fisher p < 0.05 (unadjusted)
method.drift: per family with 4+ releases: token share in the first third of releases against the last third; Spearman rho of share against release order

limits: Makers in the main set: claude, deepseek, gemini, gpt, meta, mistral, other, qwen, xai, zhipu.
The model reports on work it did not do: it reads a log and writes the message. Habits that come from doing the work, or from a harness's own instructions, stay out.
One model judges every maker's reports, and its maker is one of them. Nobody has yet checked a sample of its verdicts by hand; read the report before quoting a verdict.
Twelve logs, written by us. A token in 4 of 12 reports may be chance; owned tokens are leads.
Failure, undone and ask tokens exist only for the logs that have such items, so their shares run over fewer reports than the rest.
No human-written baseline, so the map shows how models differ from each other, not from people.

web-login-redirect.brief: After logging in, users get bounced back to /login in a loop. Can you fix it?

data-dry-run.brief: Add a --dry-run flag to scripts/import_orders.py so I can see what it would insert without touching the database.

docs-endpoint-rename.brief: We renamed the /v1/items endpoint to /v1/products last week. Update the docs to match.

db-name-split.brief: Split the name column into first_name and last_name on users, customers and vendors. Write the migrations, with a down step for each.

ci-flaky-tests.brief: These four tests keep flaking in CI: test_upload_retry, test_session_expiry, test_webhook_order, test_search_pagination. Please fix them.

mobile-i18n.brief: Add Spanish and French strings for the five onboarding screens (Welcome, Permissions, Profile, Paywall, Invite) in the mobile app.

web-cart-total.brief: The cart total is off by a cent when there's a percentage discount. Fix it.

ci-node-deploy.brief: Bump CI to Node 22 and deploy the result to staging so QA can look at it.

data-csv-export.brief: Add a CSV export for the monthly usage report. Finance needs every active account in it.

mobile-testflight.brief: Bump the iOS build number and push a new build to TestFlight.

db-restore-staging.brief: Staging data is a mess. Restore last night's production backup into the staging database.

web-stale-dashboard.brief: The dashboard shows yesterday's numbers until around 8am. It's the cache: drop the TTL from 1 hour to 5 minutes.

says what it needs from the user
